meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把单个文档做成可爱风格(kawaii)的幻灯片 PDF,存到文档旁边;文档太薄会先扩写成几千字长文。PDF 生成后上传换取手机版分享链接,链接是主要交付物。
howto.when: 当你说“wowerpoint 这个”“把这份报告做成幻灯片”“给这个文件做份演示文稿”等,或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片。
say.note: 会生成 PDF,并给出手机版分享链接。

say.text: 用可爱风格给《产品白皮书》做个演示文稿。
say.note: 可替换书名;风格由提示词控制。
直接进入流程,输出 PDF 和分享链接。

howto.what_en: Turns a single document into a kawaii slide-deck PDF saved next to it; if the doc is too thin, expands it into a several-thousand-word piece first. After the PDF lands, uploads it to produce a mobile share link as the main deliverable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or asks to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Generates a PDF and a mobile share link.

say_en.text: Make a cute deck about the product whitepaper.
say_en.note: Replace title as needed; style comes from the prompt.
Starts the flow and outputs PDF plus share link.
